## MineMenu 5.0.0 (Minecraft 1.21.1, Fabric)

### New: MineMenu on servers

- **Any server:** Minimap (without mobs), Info HUD, Chunk Borders, Zoom, Full Bright, Light Levels, Auto Sprint, mob health bars, and **waypoints**. Waypoints are kept on your computer, one list per server, and show on the HUD and minimap. These only change what you see; nothing is sent to the server.
- **Servers where you're OP** (your own server, a server with friends, your Realm): hacks and actions use Minecraft's own commands, which the server accepts because you're an operator:
  - **Player:** God Mode, Fly (creative), Speed, Super Jump, Night Vision, Fast Swim, Lava Swim, Haste, No Fall Damage, Step-Up, Long Reach, Gravity Control;
  - **World:** Always Day, Keep Inventory, Peace Mode, Freeze World;
  - **Actions:** Heal, Launch, Teleport, Day/Night/Sun/Thunder, Kill Hostile/All, Smite, Explode, TNT/Arrow/Mob Rain, Wolf Army, Netherite Kit, Clear Ground Items, Set/Go Home;
  - **Pickers:** Give Item, Spawn Mob, Give XP, Time & Weather, and Go on waypoints (with /tp).

  On a server where you aren't OP these stay greyed out with an explanation.
- **Still only in your own worlds:** everything that needs your world's own server (Morph, Freecam, Noclip, build tools with Undo, structures, Chaos Mode, combat hacks...). MineMenu doesn't fake anything to a server.
- **Playing with friends on your own server:** a short guide in the MineMenu README ("On servers").

### Fixed

- Boxes drawn in the world (build selection, paste preview, slime chunks, light levels) were rotated twice and drifted off their blocks when you looked up or down.

### Install

Fabric Loader for 1.21.1 + Fabric API, then `minemenu-5.0.0.jar` in `mods`, replacing the older version.
